title: MVMe: append command names for commands, responses and transfers to Info column.
description:
For visibility and faster scrolling, append command names to Info column.

![image](/uploads/5bb1e844318643b6c8386f4ecfc78497/image.png)


Also fixes deletion of hf_nvme_fabrics_cmd_cid and hf_nvme_tcp_unknown_data from array in packet-nvme-tcp.c, coming from !3322. Was not caught by previous validation builds but is caught now.
